text: Pick the weather for each new day on the farm from the season and what the player planted.
Name every new planet the player discovers, with a one-line description.
The traffic lights in my city builder should adapt to the traffic jams.
Write a short headline for the in-game newspaper every week from the town's stats.
Enemies in my shooter should flee when hurt and flank when they outnumber the player. There are hundreds of them.
When the player fails a puzzle three times, give a hint that does not spoil the answer.
Generate the cards of a new booster pack: name, cost from 1 to 10, attack, defense and effect text.
Let the player type commands like 'build two farms near the river' and turn them into game actions.
Balance the prices in the market based on what players buy and sell.
The goalkeeper should choose where to dive from the shooter's history.
A trivia game: generate a question with four answers and the right one, on a topic the player chooses.
Summarise what happened in the match for the end screen.
Translate chat messages between players who don't speak the same language.
The haunted house should decide which scare to play next from how scared the player seems (heart rate, walking speed).
Generate a random dungeon layout: rooms, their size and what is inside.
Check that the character names players choose are not offensive.
An AI opponent for my card game that plays reasonably well.
When the player dies, show a short epitaph that tells the story of the run.
The music intensity should follow the action on screen.
Let the player talk with the shopkeeper.
Génère une recette de potion aléatoire avec ses ingrédients et son effet.
Les villageois doivent choisir leur métier selon les besoins du village.
Adapte la difficulté des vagues de monstres au niveau du joueur.
Quand le joueur construit un pont, l'annonceur fait un commentaire court.
Crée des noms de rues pour chaque nouveau quartier de la ville.
Le chien du joueur doit réagir aux ordres tapés au clavier (assis, suis-moi, cherche).
Les gardes doivent savoir si quelqu'un a vu le joueur voler, et le dire aux autres.
Propose trois réponses possibles au joueur dans le dialogue avec la reine.
Classe les dessins des joueurs du plus drôle au moins drôle à partir de leur description.
Écris la description d'un objet trouvé par terre, en une phrase, selon le lieu.
The characters should say their lines out loud.
Let the player talk to the guard with the microphone instead of typing.
Read the quest text aloud for players who cannot read the screen.
Le marchand doit répondre à voix haute quand on lui parle au micro.
